haikus.haiku:
Soft crisp green jars gleam
Bright tang swirls softly on tongue
Joyful crunch lifts hearts
Happy #NationalPickleDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Crisp bright green dice sing
Mild lime sighs, pepper blazes
Creamy heat hugs tongue
Happy #NationalSpicyGuacamoleDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunlight drips on pond
Colors bloom like whispered song
Brush sighs in warm breeze
#HappyBirthdayClaudeMonet from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning light pours warm
Notes rise like dawn birds softly
Cake gleams with bright hope
#HappyBirthdayAaronCopland from @ClamBakeSanta
